declaration_timing: Before first new-template evaluation on discovery or development. Old baseline has already run and is frozen. Pre-split global QC exposure remains disclosed by P2.
research_principle: 旧实验只参考设计思路，不继承旧结论，不以达到旧效果为目标；全部负结果、未知状态及失败保留。
candidate_universe: Finite named templates in mtc_p3_candidate_templates.v1.json; no exhaustive field-pair search or post-development candidate expansion

candidate_support_floor.official_only_boundary: Pure official semantic constraints are source-governed separately; applying this dataset to calibrate them creates an empirical component subject to these floors.

screening_meaning: Predeclared engineering screen for research prioritization, NOT a detection metric, significance test or universal invariant. Both discovery and development must pass. Known semantic-invalid equalities remain descriptive regardless of agreement. No old effect target.
group_aggregation: Any counterexample -> COUNTEREXAMPLE; otherwise any UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN; otherwise any MATCH -> MATCH; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE. Agreement denominator MATCH + COUNTEREXAMPLE. UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE never positive support.
availability: observed + observed_value; required nonempty values; known nav memory/core 0 and explicit placeholders unknown. Legal false/0/empty arrays remain valid where semantically meaningful.
discovery_selection: Persist discovery_selection_FREEZE.json before loading development fields. Evaluate all declared templates on development to retain failures, but never rescue a discovery-rejected candidate.
tolerance_policy: 1 CSS px fixed short-side rounding tolerance. No learned coefficients, residual quantiles, retuned tolerance or threshold optimization. Exact string/ordered-array semantics, finite numeric representation normalization only.
source_policy: official_document supplies semantics, not a project predicate; official_derived constraints retain project assumptions and an empirical_selection_applied flag; collector invariants reported separately; empirical relations do not become universal laws.
production_policy: Catalog v2 is offline research only; no risk weights/attack decisions and no existing production engine/config changes. P4 required for runtime admission.
source_restrictions: No Native raw timezone negation equality
No GPU renderer literal equality as universal conflict
No webgl2_supported capability rule due shared-canvas probe artifact
No model training or detection metrics
repeatability: Only P2 primary model/OS representatives. No within-device repeatability claim or hash stability generalization without dedicated repeated sampling.
source_scope: Own final MTC inventory only, no Testin or order reconciliation; local backend/ngrok stay retired

implementation_correction.reason: Collector emits os_version as Android <release>; original parser accepted only leading digits. Three OS predicates all UNKNOWN due this implementation defect.
implementation_correction.changes: Parser accepts optional Android prefix; no candidate/expression/threshold/support-floor changes. All other outputs must reproduce.
